concurrency_and_state: Every Game1.God manager (AutoSettingManager, ClientManager, Boss, BossData, Items, ListChars, NPoint, PlayerInfo, Revive, nSkill, AutoControlPanel) uses non-thread-safe lazy singletons (`getInstance()`) with static/mutable state; Mobs uses purely public static fields/lists.

AutoSettingManager persists settings per character via `Rms.saveRMSString("nro_auto_" + charId, ...)` and `"nro_auto_default"`, caching `lastLoadedCharId` in RAM across map changes (`AutoSettingManager.cs:283-392`).
ClientManager.Update (`ClientManager.cs:25-28`) unconditionally overwrites `Char.myCharz().cspeed = speedRun` every frame when `speedRun != -1`, overriding any temporary server/skill speed modifiers.

ChatPopup relies on global static state (`currChatPopup`, `serverChatPopUp`, `nextMultiChatPopUp`, `scr`, `curr`, `last`, `performDelay`, `isHavePetNpc`), so overlapping popups or countdown tags `<...>` overwrite each other's timer and scroll state (`ChatPopup.cs:31-65, 419-431`).
ListChars caches `listPlayers` in `Update()` only while `isShow` is true, leaving stale `Char` references in `listPlayers` when toggled off (`ListChars.cs:168-178`).
cross_module_questions: Server-side movement/anti-cheat: Does the Java server validate `charMove` step distance/speed (`Mobs.GotoXY`, `Utils.Teleport`, `ClientManager.speedRun`) and `Main.gameSpeed` (`cheat` up to 100x)?
Server-side combat & cooldowns: Does the Java server enforce skill range (vs `nSkill` 1.7x `dx/dy` reach), `paintCanNotUseSkill`, and mana checks when receiving `sendPlayerAttack`?
Server-side revive & shop: Does the Java server rate-limit `wakeUpFromDead()` (spammed every 20 ticks by `Revive.PlayerRevive`) and `buyItem()` (sent every 200ms by `Items.autoBuy`)?

Client integration: How does `GameScr` dispatch the synthetic `GameCanvas.keyAsciiPress` chars (`x, c, f, m, j, k, l`) injected by `ClientManager.UpdateTouch()` (`ClientManager.cs:35-108`) now that `ClientManager.KeyPressed()` is empty?

findings.impact: Clicking the right side of the screen where ListChars was previously drawn can unintentionally focus or teleport the player to stale coordinates even when ListChars is disabled.
findings.root_cause: ListChars.Update() returns early when `!isShow` without clearing `listPlayers`, and ListChars.UpdateTouch() has no `if (!isShow) return;` guard, so it continues hit-testing stale `listPlayers` entries and calling `Utils.Teleport`/`Utils.FocusObject`.
findings.title: ListChars.UpdateTouch processes clicks and teleports even when ListChars is hidden

findings.impact: If a player queues more than one item to auto-buy, buying the first batch wipes out all queued items; starting a new buy overwrites the active quantity.
findings.root_cause: Items.autoBuy() stores target quantity in a single shared `int quantity` field rather than inside `ItemGroup`, and clears the entire `itemBuys` list (`itemBuys.Clear()`) as soon as `quantity <= 0`.
findings.title: Items.autoBuy uses a single shared quantity counter across the entire itemBuys list

findings.impact: Any invalid chat input like `k `, `k abc`, `cheat `, or non-numeric NPoint potential input crashes the client loop with unhandled exceptions; NPoint also cannot target stats above `int.MaxValue` despite using `long` fields (`hpg`, `mpg`, `dameg`).
findings.root_cause: `ClientManager.Chat` calls `float.Parse`/`int.Parse` on `text.Split(' ')[1]` without bounds or format checks; `NPoint.onChatFromMe` calls `int.Parse` without `TryParse` and does not reset `ChatTextField` on early returns (lines 179, 204).
findings.title: Unhandled int.Parse/float.Parse and missing bounds checks in ClientManager.Chat and NPoint.onChatFromMe

findings.impact: Client will spam `wakeUpFromDead()` packets indefinitely every 20 ticks while dead, bypassing the intended `maxReviveCount = 5` limit.
findings.root_cause: `Revive.reviveCount` is incremented and reset after 60s, but `Revive.maxReviveCount` is never checked in `PlayerRevive()`. Also `Char.myCharz()` is dereferenced without null check.
findings.title: Revive.maxReviveCount is never enforced in PlayerRevive()

findings.impact: Every frame when player lacks items 921 and 454 (and `isAnalog == 1`), `GUI()` iterates the entire bag and allocates two `.ToLower()` strings per item, causing heavy per-frame GC allocations.
findings.root_cause: `ClientManager.GUI()` calls `Utils.getItemFromName("bông tai")` and `TileMap.zoneID.ToString()` unconditionally inside the render loop; `getItemFromName` allocates `item.template.name.ToLower()` and `name.ToLower()` on every bag item.
findings.title: Heavy per-frame string allocations in ClientManager.GUI via Utils.getItemFromName and ToString

findings.impact: Continuous GC pressure and frame drops whenever ChatPopup, Boss HUD, ListChars, AutoSettingManager, or Menu is visible.
findings.root_cause: Multiple `paint*` methods allocate objects every frame: `ChatPopup.paint`/`paintRada` call `Res.split`, `Substring`, `new int[maxStarSlot]`, and `Res.err(...)`; `BossData.getDisplayString()`/`getElapsedTime()` concat strings every frame; `ListChars.paintPlayerMap` concats `prefix + text` every frame; `AutoSettingManager.paint` calls `GetItemValueString`; `Menu.paintMenu` allocates `new string[1]` when `subCaption` is null.
findings.title: Per-frame heap allocations in paint() across ChatPopup, BossData, ListChars, AutoSettingManager, and Menu

findings.impact: Flick velocity calculation for Menu horizontal scrolling uses stale `pointerDownLastX[1]` and `[2]` from prior touches, causing erratic inertial scroll jumps on release.
findings.root_cause: In `updateMenuKey()`, the initialization loop assigns `pointerDownLastX[0] = GameCanvas.px;` instead of `pointerDownLastX[i] = GameCanvas.px;`.
findings.title: Menu.updateMenuKey drag initialization bug overwrites index 0 instead of filling pointerDownLastX array

findings.impact: NRE crash if auto-stat is active while pet is dismissed/null, or if `perform` is invoked with `p == null`, or if `ChatPopup.perform(8000)` fires after `currChatPopup` is cleared by `Menu.startAt`.
findings.root_cause: `NPoint` accesses `Char.myPetz()` without null check when `type == TypePoint.Pet` (and reads `Char.myCharz().expForOneAdd` even for Pet at lines 77-78); `ChatPopup.addBigMessage` accesses `c.charID` without null check and `perform(8000)` dereferences `currChatPopup.currentLine` without null check.
findings.title: Missing null checks in NPoint (myPetz) and ChatPopup (c, currChatPopup)

findings.impact: Client mod exposes unguarded client-side teleportation, 100x game speedhack, and arbitrary movement speed override (`speedRun`), relying entirely on server-side validation.
findings.root_cause: `Mobs.GotoXY` and `Utils.Teleport` mutate `cx/cy` directly and send `charMove()`; `ClientManager` allows `gameSpeed` up to `100f` via `cheat` chat and unclamped `speedRun`; `nSkill` sends attacks up to `1.7 * dx/dy` reach without checking mana or updating char skill animation.
findings.title: Client-side teleport, speedhack, and extended-reach auto-attack in God mods

findings.impact: Player setting `movespeed` to 4 is silently downgraded to 2 on every load; `ClientManager.onChatFromMe` speed settings desync from `AutoSettingManager` and get overridden or mis-clamped.
findings.root_cause: `AutoSettingManager.Load` contains a hardcoded rewrite `if (key == "movespeed" && parsedVal == 4) parsedVal = 2;`; `AutoSettingManager` clamps `gameSpeed` to `[0.8, 10]` and `movespeed` to `[1, 30]`, conflicting with `ClientManager` `[0.1, 100]` and unclamped `speedRun`.
findings.title: Conflicting speed clamps and hardcoded movespeed 4->2 rewrite in AutoSettingManager

findings.impact: Dead code and unused allocations/methods bloat maintenance surface and can confuse debugging (e.g., `BossData` instantiates an empty `List<BossData>` per boss entry).
findings.root_cause: Removed UI features (`AutoControlPanel`, `PlayerInfo.paintInfoPlayer`, `ClientManager.KeyPressed`/`MenuClient`) remain partially wired or dead; `BossData` mixes singleton manager and DTO roles; `AutoSettingItem` `doFire` uses `GameCanvas.px` even on keyboard confirm.
findings.title: Mixed DTO/singleton in BossData, dead stub classes, and unused fields

findings.impact: Auto-relogin waits ~13 seconds instead of 10 seconds between retries, and `ChatPopup` `<...>` countdown parser can throw `FormatException` if text contains `<` without numeric timer format.
findings.root_cause: `PlayerInfo.Login` sets `timeWait = now + 10000L` while checking `now - timeWait >= 3000L` (effective interval 13s); `ChatPopup` uses `int.Parse` without `TryParse` or array length validation on `<...>` tags.
findings.title: 13s retry math quirk in PlayerInfo.Login and unsafe int.Parse in ChatPopup

module_summary: Batch p01 covers core client UI widgets (ChatPopup, Command, InfoDlg, Menu) and the Game1.God mod/automation suite (ClientManager, AutoSettingManager, Items, Mobs, ListChars, NPoint, PlayerInfo, Revive, nSkill, Boss/BossData, AutoControlPanel, Utils). Key issues identified are per-frame GC allocations in UI paint loops (`ChatPopup`, `ClientManager.GUI` via `Utils.getItemFromName`, `BossData`, `ListChars`, `Menu`), stale click/teleport handling in `ListChars.UpdateTouch` when hidden, shared quantity corruption in `Items.autoBuy`, unguarded `int.Parse`/`float.Parse` in chat/NPoint input, unenforced `Revive.maxReviveCount`, `Menu.updateMenuKey` flick array bug, and client-side teleport/speedhack/extended-reach attack helpers.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Auto-stat sends `(type, num)` in 1/10/100 batches every 20 ticks for Master or Pet.
Auto-attack dispatches mob `(attackMobVector, emptyVector, 1)` or player `(emptyVector, attackCharVector, 2)` packets.
`Utils.UseItem` dispatches `(0, 1, (sbyte)item.indexUI, -1)` for first matching template ID.
